# SearchWin.ai

> SearchWin.ai is a human + AI agents platform for organic lead generation in the AI search era. It gets a business found on high-intent questions in ChatGPT, Gemini and Google, and turns those visits into calls, forms and bookings. Three solutions: AI Search Sprint (45 days, one-off), AI Search Monthly (month to month) and Pages (a hub of organic conversion pages on the client's domain).

Key facts:

- Approach: everything is built for leads, not traffic. The work starts from high-intent questions (the ones people ask right before they contact someone: "best ... in ...", "... vs ...", "how much does ... cost"), uses content that sells (the answer first, proof next to the claim) and puts a next step on every page, profile and listing: a call, a form or a booking. Leads are tracked back to the page.
- Where the work happens: on the client's website, on the outside sources AI reads (Google Business Profile, directories, review platforms, mentions in publications) and on a hub of conversion pages on the client's domain.
- Who does the work: AI agents do the volume (a context agent that builds the fact base, a research agent that finds high-intent questions, an answer-check agent that re-asks the AI engines, a content agent that drafts pages, an authority agent that maps the sources AI cites, a conversion agent that follows the lead). People make the decisions: a strategist, an editor who fact-checks every page, an outreach specialist and an account lead. Nothing is published without a human edit and the client's approval.
- Who it's for: local businesses that win customers in a town or region (trades and home services, clinics and dentists, law and accounting firms, gyms and studios, restaurants), and national and international businesses (B2B services, SaaS, e-commerce, manufacturers and distributors, national brands).
- Proof: the same AI questions are re-asked on the same engines and shown next to the day-0 answers, and enquiries are counted by page.
- Engines checked: ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews and Google AI Mode; Perplexity is added for national and international work.
- What we never do: no guaranteed rankings, leads or revenue; no pages published without a human edit; no fake reviews or review gating; no fake accounts or paid posting on Reddit and forums; no lock-in contracts or hidden fees; the client owns every page, listing and account.
- First step: a free AI check (2 minutes, 3 real ChatGPT questions about your business), then a free audit and roadmap that is yours to keep.
- Markets: US, UK and EU. Quotes in dollars, euros or pounds.
- Contact: hi@searchwin.ai

## Solutions and starting prices

Each solution has a starting price. The exact scope and a fixed price are sent in writing before you pay, in US dollars, euros or British pounds. No solution promises rankings, leads or revenue.

### AI Search Sprint
45 days · one-off. Works on: your website and the outside sources AI reads. Page: https://searchwin.ai/sprint/
Fix what stops AI and Google from understanding and recommending you, build the selling pages and listings that are missing, and set up lead tracking. Re-checked on day 45 on the same questions.
- Local business: from $900, €850 or £750 one-off. Starting scope: 1 location, up to 3 services; Website fixes: AI crawler access, schema, name, address and phone consistency, indexing; Google Business Profile fix-up: categories, services, hours, photos, Q&A; 3 new or rebuilt service pages, each with a clear next step; FAQ page refresh written for AI answers; 5 directory and review-site listings set up or fixed; Review routine: request templates, QR card, reply templates; Lead capture check (click-to-call, form, booking link) with call and form tracking; Re-check: 10 questions × 3 AI engines, on day 0 and day 45; Day-45 report and a 30-minute review call.
- National & international: from $1,500, €1,400 or £1,200 one-off. Starting scope: One product or service line, one market; Website fixes: AI crawler access, schema, indexing; Brand facts fixes: facts page, schema, public profiles; 2 new answer pages: “X vs Y”, alternatives or “best for”; 3 existing pages rewritten for AI answers and for conversion; 2 review platforms set up or fixed (for example G2, Capterra or Trustpilot); Citation map: the top 20 sites AI cites in your category; Lead path check (demo, quote, trial or checkout) with AI-referral tracking; Re-check: 20 questions × 4 AI engines, on day 0 and day 45; Day-45 report and a 45-minute review call.
One-off. Pay upfront or 50/50.

### AI Search Monthly
Month to month. Works on: your website and the outside sources AI reads. Page: https://searchwin.ai/monthly/
Keep your site and your outside profiles winning new questions: a re-check every month, new and refreshed pages, review and listing upkeep, outreach for mentions and a leads report.
- Local business: from $450, €400 or £350 a month. Starting scope: Re-check: 10 questions × 3 AI engines, every month; 1 page refreshed or added a month; 4 Google posts a month; Review monitoring and reply drafts; Listings kept consistent across directories; Leads report: calls, forms and bookings; A 1-page monthly report.
- National & international: from $850, €750 or £650 a month. Starting scope: Re-check: 20 questions × 4 AI engines, every month; Share of AI mentions against named competitors; 1 new answer page a month; 1 page refresh a month; Review platform upkeep and review requests; Leads report: enquiries from AI and Google, by page; A 1-page monthly report.
Billed monthly. Cancel any month.
Monthly work starts after a sprint, or after our free audit confirms your basics are already in place.

### Pages (organic conversion pages)
Month to month. Works on: a hub of organic conversion pages on your domain. Page: https://searchwin.ai/pages/
A separate hub on your domain with a page for each high-intent search your main site does not cover: services, locations, comparisons, costs. Written to be quoted by AI, to rank in Google and to bring the enquiry.
- From $800, €700 or £600 a month. Included: Done-for-you setup, from onboarding to launch; A content hub on your domain: 100+ pages published in the first 6 months; First pages live in days, not months; Every agent and every feature on this page; A person edits every page; you approve what is published.
Billed monthly. Cancel any month.

## Pages of the site

- [Home](https://searchwin.ai/): the approach, the three solutions, the people + AI agents platform, how it works and FAQ.
- [AI Search Sprint](https://searchwin.ai/sprint/): the 45-day sprint for a website and the outside sources AI reads, with its starting prices and scope.
- [AI Search Monthly](https://searchwin.ai/monthly/): month-to-month work on the same two places, with its starting prices and scope.
- [Pages](https://searchwin.ai/pages/): organic conversion pages, a content hub on the client's domain, with its starting price and what is included.
- [FAQ](https://searchwin.ai/#faq): organic lead generation vs SEO, which solution to start with, what agents and people do, what we can and can't promise, ownership, pricing.
- [Free AI check](https://searchwin.ai/ai-check/): see in about a minute whether ChatGPT names a local business, in any country, when customers ask who to hire. Real ChatGPT answers, no sign-up.
- [Comprobación gratuita de IA, en español](https://searchwin.ai/es/ai-check/): la misma comprobación en español para negocios locales: descubre en un minuto si ChatGPT te nombra cuando los clientes preguntan a quién elegir.
